[PROGRAM 1]

SIGNALS OBSERVED: Random parents (0.9152–0.9297) and up to four randomly sampled contexts; the 0.9297 best frequently appeared. No labels were used: DIVERGE_LABEL 0, REFINE_LABEL 0. Best remained 0.9297 through 11 stagnant iterations.

WHAT SEEMED TO HELP (ONLY LIST WHAT HELPED): Lower-scoring parents often improved, reaching 0.9236–0.9274.

POTENTIAL KEY INSIGHT: Both labels were under-utilized during long stagnation—a missed opportunity.
